description: Experiment 3. An orchestrator sees each agent's prior work (history) and must assign new tasks. `kind` says which specialist has relevant context. Tasks share no content words with either history, so the right assignment needs the kind of work, not word matching (checked by tests/test_scenarios.py). Agent names are single tokens in common tokenizers so their J-lens readout is clean.

bandit_variant.description: MACE-style repeated selection. Each round the orchestrator picks a peer, then sees whether the work was accepted. True success rates are hidden; with `equal` both peers succeed with p=0.7, with `second_better` the initially less favoured peer is better (0.5 vs 0.8).
